ad_library.summary: Dr. Sridhar Dental is the best-tracked lead in this batch: GA4 (G-7Y9ND039HL) and a Google Ads conversion tag (AW-855095874) are both in the served HTML, and the Google Ads Transparency Centre shows 42 live ads. Meta is the weak side - five active ads, mostly Telugu brand films and motivational clips that point at the Instagram profile or the homepage rather than a treatment page, and no Meta Pixel in the source, so the Facebook audience can never be retargeted. The site itself is a client-rendered React shell: the HTML served to a crawler contains no H1, no meta description and no structured data, so everything Google reads about treatments, doctors and branches depends on it executing JavaScript.

scope_note: sridhardental.com serves a client-rendered React shell (/static/js/main.ed92a87d.js) with an empty root div, so what a crawler receives is not what a patient sees. GA4 G-7Y9ND039HL and Google Ads AW-855095874 are in that shell and will fire in the browser; the absence of a Meta Pixel is a source-code observation over the served HTML. No H1, no meta description, no Open Graph tags and no JSON-LD are present in the served HTML - they may be injected after JavaScript runs, which a page read cannot confirm, so the H1 count is recorded as unchecked rather than zero. The services page carries no enquiry form (the booking page does), and the form itself was not assessed.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
